title: relay: reset first when the user comes back to a cold cache
description: when a user message lands on a big context after pi's prompt cache expired (5 min by default; cacheWarming streaming stops warming when a run ends), reset with relay's code-built summary first, then run the message on the small context. cost on opus 5.5 (input $4/M, cache write $5/M, read $0.20/M): a cold return at 400K is ~$2.00, after a reset ~$0.18. there's no handoff note (no model call), so the summary's last ~30 exchanges carry the detail. junto's rules to borrow (github.com/skastr0/junto src/shared/seat-offboard.ts, operator-offboard.ts): only cut a session worth it (30+ min of work or ~200K tokens; never an empty or tiny one), and a session open in front of the operator is asked first (auto) or never cut (hybrid, their default); decide ours (pi-web prompt? /relay setting?). first check whether pi lets an extension write the reset before a prompt runs (input / before_agent_start).

title: relay: nudge thresholds in tokens, a % of the window as the fallback
description: today relay nudges at 40% of the window, then every 5% (400K on opus 5.5's 1M window). the user's real cap is ~400K tokens whatever the model: let PI_RELAY_NUDGE_AT / NUDGE_EVERY take tokens (400k, 50k) besides percents. for a model whose window is smaller than the target, nudge at whichever comes first (the token target or a % of the window), so it still nudges before the window fills; that matters more when pi's auto-compaction is off (compaction.enabled is a toggle).
